adminGuestInvite.title: Guest invite link
adminGuestInvite.description:
Anyone opening a link with this token signs in with Discord and joins as a guest.
Guests aren't in the guild role, but they can be assigned to event slots and view participation history. Clear the token to disable the invite link.
